function.description: Request a separate diagnostic context: distinguish evidence reading from an explicit saved_state_check numerical grant. Production changes and backend execution require separate authority.
function.name: diagnosis_request

path.description: Exact existing-field JSON pointer relative to draft.arguments, e.g. /new_facts/0/references. The explicit draft-root spelling /arguments/new_facts/0/references is also supported. No guessed paths.
path.title: Path

SavedStateScope.description: Explicit numerical authorization, separate from retained-evidence reading.

numerical_limits.description: Maximum numerical units within this request; bounded by the frozen project grant.
numerical_limits.title: Numerical Limits

SavedStateScope.title: SavedStateScope

scope.description: Distinguish retained-evidence reads, explicitly authorized saved-state numerical work, and excluded production changes/backend execution.
scope.title: Scope

function.description: Read immutable saved evidence with JSON Pointer and offset paging. An oversized subtree returns a labeled pointer overview, not original content. Follow its pointers using the same source reference and next_offset at the same pointer. No solve or evaluation is performed.
function.name: evidence_read

path.description: Exact existing-field JSON pointer relative to draft.arguments, e.g. /new_facts/0/references. The explicit draft-root spelling /arguments/new_facts/0/references is also supported. No guessed paths.
path.title: Path

byte_limit.description: Requested content byte cap; response and observation envelopes also count toward the inline limit. Pages may be smaller. Follow next_offset at the same pointer.
byte_limit.title: Byte Limit

pointer.description: JSON Pointer into original evidence, e.g. /detail or /signals/0/values. Empty reads the root. Oversized nested content returns a labeled overview with valid child pointers; follow those pointers using the same source reference.
pointer.title: Pointer

reference.description: Existing immutable evidence reference, not a node_id. A build has no evaluation or trajectory to read.
